description: A notes panel to go with Jooper. Names are typed against eight inputs and eight outputs, stored as a numbered scene, and the scenes are stepped through with the commands along the bottom

params.text: Stores the names now on the panel as a new scene at the end
Puts the current scene's names onto the panel
Goes to the scene after the current one
Goes to the scene before the current one
Writes the names now on the panel over the current scene
Stores the names now on the panel as a new scene before the current one

inputs.text: A voltage chooses which scene is the current one
A pulse goes to the scene after the current one
A pulse goes to the scene before the current one
A pulse puts the current scene's names onto the panel
A pulse stores the names now on the panel as a new scene at the end
A pulse goes to the first scene
A pulse deletes the current scene
A pulse writes the names now on the panel over the current scene
A pulse stores the names now on the panel as a new scene before the current one

notes: Initialize empties every text field and leaves the stored scenes alone; the scenes are cleared with the delete-all command.
